literal_meaning: বৃদ্ধির উপর বৃদ্ধি (reduplicative form indicating excess increase)
figurative_meaning_en: Reduplicative word; increase in severity or aggravation
similar_in_english: take a turn for the worse
example_sentences_in_english: His illness has taken a turn for the worse.
The worsening weather is troubling everyone.
note: Commonly used in contexts of illness or escalating problems in everyday Bengali speech.
